briefs.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Production sprite sheet for an ORIGINAL 2D vertical-scrolling science adventure game. Subject: an original charming cartoon of historical scientist Michael Faraday around age 35, voluminous wavy brown hair, clean-shaven face, kind determined eyes, white high collar and cravat, dark teal Victorian coat, brass goggles on forehead. He pilots a compact fantastical copper-and-teal induction-powered flying machine, rounded cockpit, two elegant brass mechanical wings, visible copper coil rings, little turquoise electrical generator behind him, two small spinning propellers. No weapons resembling a known franchise. Top-down three-quarter camera: machine nose points UP, pilot's expressive face visible as he glances upward at viewer. Create exactly 8 separate animation cels, in a PERFECT uniform 4-column 2-row grid on 1536x1024 transparent PNG. Each sprite MUST fit within its 384x512 cell, maximum occupied width 300 pixels, with at least 42-pixel transparent left/right padding. No wing or effects can cross cells. Same body center, pilot face and torso placement and scale throughout. Eight clear looping flying animation poses: propeller blades rotate successively, copper generator rotor rotates, mechanical wings flex gently, scarf flutters and hair bounces. Crisp high quality hand-painted 2D game art, readable silhouette, warm copper orange, brass gold, deep teal, cyan glow. No background, ground, shadows, grid, text, typography, watermark or labels. True transparent alpha. Maintain exact same character identity in all eight frames, and generous cell margins. Full complete sprite in every cell.

Use case: stylized-concept. Original production sprite animation atlas for a polished steampunk science flying shooter with Faraday as hero. EXACT uniform grid 4 columns x 3 rows, 12 sprites total on 1536x1024 PNG with true transparent background. Row1: small mischievous purple copper clockwork flying beetle drone with crimson glass eyes and brass wing joints. Row2: squat blue iron turret drone with orange central lens and twin brass rotor blades. Row3: angular crimson brass scout drone with amber core and thin mechanical wings. Four frames per row are successive distinctive rotor/spinning-wing flight animation poses of the SAME enemy, identity and torso position locked. Enemies face DOWN. Top-down three-quarter game camera. Every sprite max width 290 pixels and max height 240 pixels, centered inside its 384x341 cell with generous clear margins; never overlap cells. Premium hand-painted cartoon game asset, detailed brass rivets, polished copper, clean outlined silhouettes at small scale, rich jewel tones, charming rather than realistic military. No humanoids, no franchise characters, no real logos. No labels, text, grid, shadows or background: true alpha. All twelve animation frames distinct.

Use case: stylized-concept. Production animated boss sprite sheet for an ORIGINAL steampunk scientist flying game. EXACT grid 4 columns x 2 rows, eight frames on 1536x1024 transparent PNG. Same imposing giant clockwork sky guardian in every cell: an oval dark indigo iron airship automaton with wide brass mechanical wings, two round amber glass eyes, luminous cyan electric generator core ringed with thick copper coils at its chest, iron plated tail, propeller turbines in wings, engraved subtle gold trim, one big copper rotor. A magical 19th-century science-fiction machine, not a creature and no human. Top-down slightly frontal view, facing DOWN toward the player. Each frame shows successive rotor rotation and mechanical wing flexing, distinct animation, same body scale and face/core location locked. Full sprite in each 384x512 cell, MAX occupied width 300px, MAX height 380px, at least 42px clear transparent side padding, never overlap. Bold clean silhouette, beautiful high quality painted game illustration with crisp highlights and saturated cyan/copper contrast. No labels, letters, words, numbers, watermark, background or shadow, genuine alpha transparency. No existing character likeness.

Same character centered at same body scale in all four cells. High quality hand-painted game art, crisp recognizable silhouette, brass/copper/teal/navy jewel colors. Frontal top-down three-quarter view, enemy faces down toward player. No text, letters, numbers, logos, background, gridlines or ground. Actual alpha transparency. Four distinct looping mechanical animation poses. Subject: The Scrap Colossus, a fantastical flying automaton representing scarcity of resources, not a poor person. A huge ROUND patched iron money-box body with a brass empty coin slot, warm amber eyes, enormous asymmetrical scrap-metal fists, dented copper shoulder plates, small cloth patch repairs and two propeller turbines holding it in the sky. Expressive mechanical face, rusty burnt-orange and slate-teal palette. It clenches then opens fists and turbines spin in four phases. A lovable intimidating mechanical toy, no human caricature. Keep entire silhouette including fists and turbines within every cell.
